consume_requests: consume requests from an iterator and add them to a gRPC handler in a background thread
blocking_unary_response: get a blocking unary response from a gRPC handler and return the result or raise an error
blocking_unary_response_with_call: get a blocking unary response and a Call object from a gRPC handler for inspection
future_call: create a FutureCall object from a gRPC handler for async unary response handling
ResponseIteratorCall: iterate over streaming responses from a gRPC handler using a ResponseIteratorCall object
